headline: IRAN 🇮🇷 OFFERS 🫱 US 🇺🇸 DEAL 🤝 To REOPEN 🚪 Strait 🌊 Of Hormuz In SEVEN 7️⃣ DAYS ⏳
text:
IRAN 🇮🇷 is straight UP 🆙 edging 🍆 the US 🇺🇸 with a fresh 🔥 proposal 📜 to pop 🫧 the Strait 🌊 of Hormuz back open 🚪 in just SEVEN 7️⃣ DAYS ⏳ if the necessary 🍆 conditions 🧾 from that June 📅 MOU 📋 get met ✅!! Foreign 🗣️ Minister 👔 Abbas 🧔 Araghchi dropped 🫳 this bombshell 💣 at the UN 🏛️ in New 🆕 York 🗽 telling 📢 reporters 📰 the whole plan 🗺️ was already shipped 📦 to Washington via Qatar 🇶🇦 and now the choice 🫵 sits squarely with Trump 🧑‍💼!! He kept 🗣️ repeating 🔁 that everything is prepared 🛠️ if the US side shows real seriousness 😤 and the strait 🌊 can return to normal 🚢 maritime passage within that tight one week window 🪟!! A random UN intern 👀 whispered that Araghchi Daddy 🧔‍♂️ looked extra confident 😎 while laying out the terms like he was teasing 🍑 the climax of this whole geopolitical edging session!!

US officials 🕴️ told the BBC 📻 that constructive 🛠️ discussions 💬 are indeed happening through multiple mediators 🤝 including juicy 🍒 talks about nuclear ☢️ issues 🧪!! This comes right after President Trump 🧑‍💼 threatened to straight ANNIHILATE 💥 the Islamic Republic if no deal 🤝 materializes soon!! The MOU 📜 signed back on June 18 📆 was supposed to trigger a ceasefire 🤝 plus partial reopening of that vital oil artery 🛢️ but both sides went back to trading blows 👊 faster than you can say blue balls 🥜!! Araghchi made it crystal clear that the steps Washington needs to take are literally already written ✍️ inside that same fourteen point agreement 📑 and Iran is not here for any coercion 💪 or annihilation threats 🌋!!

Before this war 🔥 erupted the Strait 🌊 of Hormuz used to carry TWENTY 20️⃣ percent of the entire planet's oil 🛢️ and liquefied natural gas 🧪 until Iran blocked 🚫 it in response to US 🇺🇸 and Israeli ✡️ air strikes ✈️ on February 28 📅!! Tehran then launched its own attacks 🗯️ on Israel 🇮🇱 American bases 🪖 in the Gulf 🌊 and several Arab allies 🤝 while also hitting vessels 🚢 trying to cross without permission!! That closure sent energy prices 💰 into absolute chaos 🤪 and put massive pressure on Trump 🧑‍💼 especially with Congressional elections 🗳️ looming in November 🍂!! Shipping data 📊 now shows only about eighteen 🚢 transits per day on average with some days dipping as low as nine boats 🛥️ according to Kpler analysts!!

The original MOU 📋 promised Iran would never pursue a nuclear weapon ☢️ while both sides plus their buddies would halt all military operations 🛑 on every front including ending the US naval blockade 🚫 and giving sanctions relief 💸!! Iran also agreed to use best efforts for safe commercial passage 🛳️ through the strait and chat with Oman 🇴🇲 about future shipping rules!! Trump has been bragging 🗣️ that the US is successfully getting oil out anyway but those low daily numbers tell a different thirsty story 🥵!! Meanwhile Yemen's Houthis 🇾🇪 who are tight with Iran have been cranking up attacks on Saudi oil installations 🏜️ and just seized big chunks of the Red Sea coast including the port of Mokha that stares right at the Bab al-Mandab chokepoint 🌊!!

Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman 👑 reportedly begged Trump for military backup 🪖 after those fresh Houthi missile 🚀 and drone attacks got intercepted by the Saudi led coalition 🛡️ on Saturday!! Araghchi clapped back 🗣️ at the UN this week saying Iran rejects all coercion 💪 threats or intimidation and that real peace cannot be built on talk of driving anyone into hell 🔥!! Trump himself mused out loud during his General Assembly speech 🗣️ whether he should cut a deal that lets Iran rebuild bigger than ever or just annihilate the Islamic Republic quickly so they never get to kill again!! A US official bragged that America holds a very strong position with control of the strait so they are not in any rush 🏃‍♂️ while positive mediator talks continue!!
